raw.details:
Your Ideas. Your Innovation. Your Future.

Welcome to NOVATRIX 2026, an Open Innovation Hackathon organized by AltairX Tech.

NOVATRIX provides a platform for creative thinkers, developers, and aspiring innovators to transform their ideas into impactful solutions. Participants are free to explore any domain, identify real-world challenges, and build innovative solutions using technology and creativity.

Event Details:

Event: NOVATRIX 2026

  • Organizer: AltairX Tech
  • Mode: Online
  • Participation: Individual
  • Type: Open Innovation Hackathon

Innovation Domains:

Participants can build projects in any domain, including:

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  • Web and Mobile App Development
  • FinTech and Business Solutions
  • Healthcare and Education
  • Cybersecurity and Blockchain
  • IoT and Hardware Innovation
  • Sustainability and Social Impact
  • Any other innovative domain of choice

Rules and Guidelines:

  • Projects must be original and developed during the official hackathon period.
  • Participants may explore ideas and identify problem statements beforehand, but project development must begin only after the hackathon starts.
  • Previously completed projects and plagiarism are strictly prohibited.
  • Participants must follow the submission guidelines and deadlines.
  • All submissions must include the required project details and supporting materials.
  • Organizers reserve the right to disqualify entries that violate the rules.

Evaluation Criteria:

Projects will be evaluated based on:

  • Innovation and Creativity
  • Problem Relevance
  • Technical Implementation
  • Feasibility
  • Overall Impact

Recognition:

Participants will receive an Excellence Certificate and an opportunity to be featured on AltairX Tech's official social media platforms.

Ready to Innovate?

Come with an idea. Build it within the challenge. Make an impact.

Join NOVATRIX 2026 and turn your imagination into innovation!
